recipes.title: Start a timer
recipes.desc: Starts a countdown right away, without opening the clock app.

vars.label: Duration in seconds
vars.where: Multiply minutes by 60: 5 minutes is 300, 1 hour is 3600.

recipes.title: Start a labelled timer
recipes.desc: Starts a countdown with a name, for example "Pasta".

vars.name: SECONDS
vars.label: Duration in seconds
vars.where: Multiply minutes by 60: 10 minutes is 600.

vars.name: LABEL
vars.label: Name of the timer

recipes.title: Set an alarm
recipes.desc: Creates an alarm at the time you choose, without opening the clock app.

vars.label: Hour (0 to 23)
vars.where: 24-hour clock: 7 for 7 am, 19 for 7 pm.

vars.name: MINUTES
vars.label: Minutes (0 to 59)
vars.where: Just the minutes of the time.

recipes.title: Set a labelled alarm
recipes.desc: Creates an alarm with a name, for example "Gym".

vars.name: HOUR
vars.label: Hour (0 to 23)
vars.where: 24-hour clock: 7 for 7 am, 19 for 7 pm.

vars.name: MINUTES
vars.label: Minutes (0 to 59)
vars.where: Just the minutes of the time.

vars.name: LABEL
vars.label: Name of the alarm
vars.where: Any short text.

recipes.title: Show the alarms

recipes.title: Show the timers

recipes.title: Open the camera in photo mode

recipes.title: Open the camera in video mode
recipes.desc: Opens the default camera app ready to film.

recipes.title: Dial a number

vars.label: Email address
vars.where: The person you write to.

vars.name: SUBJECT
vars.label: Subject
vars.where: Any short text.

vars.label: Message

vars.label: Search text

recipes.title: Create an event

vars.name: TITLE

vars.where: Any short text.

recipes.title: Open the calendar
recipes.desc: Opens your calendar on today.

recipes.title: Create a contact
recipes.desc: Opens a new contact with the name and phone number already filled in.

vars.name: NAME
vars.label: Name
vars.where: Any name.

vars.name: NUMBER
vars.label: Phone number
vars.where: With the country code, for example +33123456789.

recipes.title: Wi-Fi settings
recipes.desc: Opens the list of Wi-Fi networks.

recipes.title: Bluetooth settings

recipes.title: Airplane mode settings
recipes.desc: Opens the airplane mode settings.

recipes.title: Display settings

recipes.title: NFC settings

recipes.desc: Opens the accessibility settings.

recipes.desc: Opens the language settings.

recipes.title: Date and time settings
recipes.desc: Opens the date and time settings.

recipes.title: All apps
recipes.desc: Opens the list of installed apps.

recipes.title: Developer options
recipes.desc: Opens the developer options (when they are unlocked).

recipes.title: Navigate to an address
recipes.desc: Starts turn-by-turn driving navigation in Google Maps from your current position to an address or place name.

vars.name: ADDRESS
vars.label: Destination address or place name
vars.where: Type the full street address or a well-known place name, exactly as you would search it in Google Maps.

recipes.note: Starts guidance from your current position. Google Maps asks for location access the first time.

recipes.title: Walk to an address
recipes.desc: Starts walking navigation in Google Maps from your current position to an address or place name.

vars.name: ADDRESS
vars.label: Destination address or place name
vars.where: Type the full street address or a well-known place name, exactly as you would search it in Google Maps.

recipes.note: Starts walking guidance from your current position.

recipes.title: Cycle to an address
recipes.desc: Starts bicycling navigation in Google Maps from your current position to an address or place name.

vars.name: ADDRESS
vars.label: Destination address or place name
vars.where: Type the full street address or a well-known place name, exactly as you would search it in Google Maps.

recipes.note: Cycling directions are not available in every country.

recipes.title: Search places nearby
recipes.desc: Opens Google Maps with the results of a search such as restaurants or pharmacies around you.

vars.name: SEARCH
vars.label: What to search for
vars.where: Type a place type or a name, the same words you would type in the Google Maps search bar.

recipes.note: Opens Google Maps with the results of the search.

recipes.title: Public transport to a place
recipes.desc: Shows public transport directions to a destination in Google Maps, starting from your current location.

vars.name: DESTINATION
vars.label: Destination address or place name
vars.where: Type an address or a place name, the way you would search it in Google Maps.

recipes.note: Opens the route in Google Maps, or in the browser if the app does not take it.

recipes.title: Open Street View at coordinates
recipes.desc: Opens the Street View panorama closest to a latitude and longitude in Google Maps.

vars.name: LATITUDE
vars.label: Latitude
vars.where: In Google Maps, long-press a spot on the map: the latitude is the first number shown in the search bar.

vars.name: LONGITUDE
vars.label: Longitude
vars.where: In Google Maps, long-press a spot on the map: the longitude is the second number shown in the search bar.

recipes.note: If there is no panorama near this point, Google Maps says so.

recipes.title: Open the voice assistant
recipes.desc: Starts the default assistant of the phone, like the system gesture does.

recipes.title: Open a channel
recipes.desc: Opens a YouTube channel page from its handle.

vars.name: HANDLE
vars.label: Channel handle (without the @)
vars.where: Open the channel in YouTube: the handle starts with @ under the channel name; type it here without the @.

recipes.note: Opens the channel page in the YouTube app.

recipes.title: Open a playlist
recipes.desc: Opens a specific YouTube playlist.

vars.name: PLAYLIST_ID
vars.label: Playlist ID
vars.where: Open the playlist page and tap Share > Copy link (or read the address in a browser); the ID is the part after list= in the link.

recipes.note: Opens the playlist page. It does not start playing by itself.

recipes.title: Open a video
recipes.desc: Opens a specific video, for example a favourite live stream or tutorial.

vars.name: VIDEO_ID
vars.label: Video ID
vars.where: Open the video, tap Share > Copy link; the ID is the part after v= (or after youtu.be/ in a short link).

recipes.note: Opens the video in the YouTube app.

recipes.title: Search YouTube
recipes.desc: Opens YouTube search results for a fixed query.

vars.name: QUERY
vars.label: Search text
vars.where: Any words you want to look up.

recipes.note: Opens the search results.

recipes.title: Open your library
recipes.desc: Opens the Library tab of YouTube Music.
recipes.note: Needs a signed-in YouTube Music app.

recipes.title: Search YouTube Music
recipes.desc: Opens YouTube Music search results for a fixed query.

vars.name: QUERY
vars.label: Search text
vars.where: Any words you want to look up.

recipes.note: Opens the search results in YouTube Music.

recipes.title: Open a playlist
recipes.desc: Opens a specific playlist or album playlist in YouTube Music.

vars.name: PLAYLIST_ID
vars.label: Playlist ID
vars.where: Open the playlist in YouTube Music, tap the menu > Share > Copy link; the ID is the part after list= in the link.

recipes.note: Opens the playlist or album in YouTube Music.

recipes.title: Open a song
recipes.desc: Opens a specific song in the YouTube Music player.

vars.name: VIDEO_ID
vars.label: Song ID
vars.where: Open the song, tap the menu > Share > Copy link; the ID is the part after v= in the link.

recipes.note: Opens the song in YouTube Music.

recipes.title: Write a new email
recipes.desc: Opens the Gmail compose screen with an empty message.
recipes.note: Nothing is sent until you tap Send.

recipes.title: Write an email to someone
recipes.desc: Opens the Gmail compose screen with the recipient filled in.

vars.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
vars.label: Recipient email address
vars.where: Type the address of the person you write to most often.

recipes.note: Nothing is sent until you tap Send.

recipes.title: Write an email with a subject and text
recipes.desc: Opens the Gmail compose screen with subject and body already filled in.

vars.name: SUBJECT
vars.label: Subject
vars.where: Type the subject line.

vars.name: BODY
vars.label: Message text
vars.where: Type the body of the email.
vars.example: Hello, please find the weekly report below.

recipes.note: Nothing is sent until you tap Send.

recipes.title: Open a chat by username
recipes.desc: Opens the conversation with a public Telegram user, group, channel or bot.

vars.name: USERNAME
vars.label: Telegram username
vars.where: The public name without the @, shown on the profile under Username.

recipes.note: Works for people, groups, channels and bots that have a public username.

recipes.title: Open a chat with a message typed
recipes.desc: Opens a public chat and pre-fills the message box (nothing is sent until you press send).

vars.name: USERNAME
vars.label: Telegram username
vars.where: The public name without the @, shown on the profile under Username.

vars.name: MESSAGE
vars.label: Message
vars.where: Your text, as you would type it.

recipes.note: The text is typed in the message box; nothing is sent until you press send.

recipes.title: Open a chat by phone number
recipes.desc: Opens the Telegram conversation with a person identified by their phone number.

vars.name: PHONE_NUMBER
vars.label: Phone number
vars.where: Country code first, digits only, for example 33123456789. Spaces and + are ignored.

recipes.note: Works only if that person has Telegram and lets people find them by number.

recipes.title: Join a private group by invite link
recipes.desc: Opens the join prompt of a private Telegram group or channel from its invite hash.

vars.name: INVITE_HASH
vars.label: Invite hash
vars.where: In an invite link like https://t.me/+AbCdEf123, copy what follows the + (older links: t.me/joinchat/HASH).

recipes.note: Opens the invitation to a private group or channel.

recipes.title: Open the story composer
recipes.desc: Opens Telegram's story camera/composer to post a new story.
recipes.note: Opens the screen to create a story.

recipes.title: Open global search
recipes.desc: Opens Telegram's search screen over all chats and public content.
recipes.note: Opens the search screen.

recipes.title: Open a chat
recipes.desc: Opens a WhatsApp conversation with a given phone number.

vars.name: PHONE_NUMBER
vars.label: Phone number
vars.where: Country code first, digits only, for example 33123456789. Spaces and + are ignored.

recipes.note: Opens the conversation with this number.

recipes.title: Open a chat with a ready message
recipes.desc: Opens a WhatsApp conversation with a phone number and pre-fills the message box (nothing is sent until you press send).

vars.name: PHONE_NUMBER
vars.label: Phone number
vars.where: Country code first, digits only, for example 33123456789. Spaces and + are ignored.

vars.name: MESSAGE
vars.label: Message
vars.where: Your text, as you would type it.

recipes.note: The text is typed in the message box; nothing is sent until you press send.

recipes.title: Send a text to a contact I pick
recipes.desc: Opens WhatsApp's contact picker with the message already typed, so you choose who receives it.

vars.name: MESSAGE
vars.label: Message
vars.where: Your text, as you would type it.

recipes.note: WhatsApp asks you to pick who receives the text.

recipes.title: Join or open a group by invite link
recipes.desc: Opens a WhatsApp group from its invite code (join prompt, or the group if already a member).

vars.name: INVITE_CODE
vars.label: Group invite code
vars.where: The part after chat.whatsapp.com/ in the group's invite link (in the group: Group info > Invite via link > Copy link).

recipes.note: Opens the invitation to a group.

recipes.title: Open a chat by phone number
recipes.desc: Opens a Signal conversation with a person identified by their phone number.

vars.name: PHONE_NUMBER
vars.label: Phone number
vars.where: Country code first, digits only, for example 33123456789. Spaces and + are ignored.

recipes.note: Opens the conversation with this number if the person uses Signal.

recipes.title: Join or open a group by group link
recipes.desc: Opens the Signal join prompt for a group from its group link.

vars.name: GROUP_LINK_CODE
vars.label: Group link code
vars.where: In Signal: open the group > tap its name > Group link > Share/Copy; keep only the long text after the # in https://signal.group/#...

recipes.note: Opens the invitation to a Signal group.

recipes.title: Open my vault
recipes.desc: Opens the chosen Obsidian vault (focuses it if already open).

vars.name: VAULT_NAME
vars.label: Vault name
vars.where: In Obsidian, open the vault switcher (vault icon, bottom of the sidebar or the vault list) and copy the name shown for your vault; it is also the name of its folder.

recipes.note: Opens the vault on its last screen.

recipes.title: Open a specific note
recipes.desc: Opens one precise note of the vault.

vars.name: VAULT_NAME
vars.label: Vault name
vars.where: In Obsidian, open the vault switcher (vault icon, bottom of the sidebar or the vault list) and copy the name shown for your vault; it is also the name of its folder.

vars.name: NOTE_PATH
vars.label: Note name or path
vars.where: The note file name, or its path from the vault root; the .md extension can be left out.

recipes.note: Opens this note of the vault.

recipes.title: Open today's daily note
recipes.desc: Creates or opens today's daily note.

vars.name: VAULT_NAME
vars.label: Vault name
vars.where: In Obsidian, open the vault switcher (vault icon, bottom of the sidebar or the vault list) and copy the name shown for your vault; it is also the name of its folder.

recipes.note: Opens today's daily note, or creates it.

recipes.title: Create a new note
recipes.desc: Creates a new note with the given name (using the vault's default location for new notes) and opens it.

vars.name: VAULT_NAME
vars.label: Vault name
vars.where: In Obsidian, open the vault switcher (vault icon, bottom of the sidebar or the vault list) and copy the name shown for your vault; it is also the name of its folder.

vars.name: NOTE_NAME
vars.label: Name of the new note
vars.where: Type the title you want; the file is created as <title>.md.

recipes.note: Creates the note if it does not exist. Obsidian must be able to reach the vault.

recipes.title: Add a line to today's daily note
recipes.desc: Appends the given text to the end of today's daily note.

vars.name: VAULT_NAME
vars.label: Vault name
vars.where: In Obsidian, open the vault switcher (vault icon, bottom of the sidebar or the vault list) and copy the name shown for your vault; it is also the name of its folder.

vars.name: TEXT_TO_ADD
vars.label: Text to append
vars.where: The text to add, as you would type it.

recipes.note: Adds the text at the end of today's daily note.

recipes.title: Search my vault
recipes.desc: Opens Obsidian search in the vault and runs the query.

vars.name: VAULT_NAME
vars.label: Vault name
vars.where: In Obsidian, open the vault switcher (vault icon, bottom of the sidebar or the vault list) and copy the name shown for your vault; it is also the name of its folder.

vars.name: SEARCH_TEXT
vars.label: Search text
vars.where: Type the word or phrase to look for.

recipes.note: Opens the search with this text.

recipes.title: Open a dashboard page
recipes.desc: Opens a chosen Home Assistant dashboard view inside the companion app.

vars.name: DASHBOARD_PATH
vars.label: Dashboard path
vars.where: Open the page in the Home Assistant web interface and copy the path after the address and port, without the first slash.

recipes.note: Opens a dashboard or a view of Home Assistant.

recipes.note: Opens the playlist. It does not start playing by itself.

recipes.title: Open an artist page
recipes.desc: Opens the page of a Spotify artist.

vars.name: ARTIST_ID
vars.label: Artist ID
vars.where: In Spotify tap the three dots, then Share, then Copy link. The ID is the part after /artist/ and before any ?si=.

recipes.title: Open an album
recipes.desc: Opens a Spotify album.

vars.name: ALBUM_ID
vars.label: Album ID
vars.where: In Spotify tap the three dots, then Share, then Copy link. The ID is the part after /album/ and before any ?si=.

recipes.note: Opens the album.

recipes.title: Open a track
recipes.desc: Opens a Spotify track.

vars.name: TRACK_ID
vars.label: Track ID

recipes.note: Opens the track.

recipes.desc: Opens a Deezer playlist.

recipes.title: Open an artist page
recipes.desc: Opens the page of a Deezer artist.

vars.name: ARTIST_ID
vars.label: Artist ID
vars.where: Open the artist on deezer.com in a browser. The ID is the number at the end of the address.

recipes.note: Opens the artist page.

recipes.title: Open an album
recipes.desc: Opens a Deezer album.

vars.name: ALBUM_ID
vars.label: Album ID
vars.where: Open the album on deezer.com in a browser. The ID is the number at the end of the address.

recipes.title: Open a track
recipes.desc: Opens a Deezer track.

vars.name: TRACK_ID
vars.label: Track ID
vars.where: Open the track on deezer.com in a browser. The ID is the number at the end of the address.

recipes.note: Opens the track.

recipes.title: Search Deezer
recipes.desc: Opens Deezer search results for a fixed query.

vars.name: QUERY
vars.label: Search text
vars.where: Any words you want to look up, for example an artist name.

recipes.note: Opens the search results.

recipes.desc: Opens an album, playlist or artist from its Apple Music link.

vars.name: LINK
vars.label: Apple Music link
vars.where: Open the page on music.apple.com, click More, then Copy Link, and paste the whole address.

recipes.note: Opens in the Apple Music app if your phone lets it handle the link, otherwise in the browser.
